general.notes: Family SO-SFP-1G-O-Cxx-E: OSC at 100Mbps and 1Gbps Ethernet up to 80km; on data link disruption or failure to connect, transmitter switches to OTDR mode. Power budget 0–23dB. Transmitter/receiver min/max and overload per footnote 1) Average power; receiver min/overload per footnote 2) at 1.25Gbps PRBS7 and BER 1x10-12. Nominal/transmit wavelength rows 3)–6) map to SO-SFP-1G-O-C49-E, C51-E, C61-E, C62-E respectively. Receiver wavelength range 1260–1635nm. OTDR: dynamic range Typ 65dB, dead zone Max 30m, resolution Max 10m, accuracy Max 50m. Storage temperature -40°C to +85°C. DDM Yes. Ordering descriptions: FE/1G 23dB, OTDR 65dB, E-temp, LC.
